instrument: Mayoral proposal for a citywide data center moratorium
summary: Ordinance introduced Sept 23, 2026 by Mayor Johnson and Ald. Robinson (4th), co-sponsored by Ald. Hadden (49th) and Manaa-Hoppenworth (48th), to pause new data centers and the material expansion of existing ones for 12 months while the Data Centers Task Force develops regulations. Not yet adopted.
confidence_note: Relayed; no ordinance text read and no council action taken.

source.citation: City of Chicago press release (search excerpt; site blocks automated reading); Block Club Chicago and Chicago Tribune, Sept 23-24, 2026
